dhjourneymap.configuration.title: DH JourneyMap Bridge
dhjourneymap.configuration.enabled.toolt: Show Distant Horizons terrain in unexplored parts of the fullscreen map.
New estimates are built from DH (and refreshed) only within this many blocks of the player. Already saved estimates show everywhere.
dhjourneymap.configuration.tint.tooltip: How strongly estimated areas are tinted. 0 = DH colours unchanged, 1 = full sepia.
dhjourneymap.configuration.hillshade.too: Shade slopes so terrain height is readable.
dhjourneymap.configuration.hideDecoratio: Use the ground below flowers, grass, saplings etc. Avoids coloured specks, since one map pixel covers 4x4 blocks.
Show the DH biome in the map's hover text where JourneyMap has no data.
dhjourneymap.configuration.refreshSecond: How often visible estimated tiles are rebuilt to pick up newly generated DH terrain.
dhjourneymap.configuration.maxTiles.tool: Most estimated regions kept in memory (about 64 KB video memory + 16 KB RAM each; 1024 = ~64 MB VRAM + ~16 MB RAM). Off-screen ones are dropped first and reload from disk when you pan back.
dhjourneymap.configuration.bakeThreads.t: Threads building estimated tiles. 0 = automatic (2-4 depending on CPU). Needs a restart.
dhjourneymap.configuration.clearEstimate: Delete the saved DH estimate for this world. JourneyMap's real map is not touched. Only available in a world.
dhjourneymap.clearEstimate.confirm.title: Clear the estimated map for this world?
dhjourneymap.clearEstimate.confirm.messa: Deletes all saved DH estimate tiles (all dimensions). JourneyMap's real map stays as it is. The estimate rebuilds from Distant Horizons data the next time you open the map.
